summary: Shlink is a self-hosted URL shortener that lets you create and manage short links on your own domain. It provides a REST API and a command line interface for automation, alongside an official progressive web application for management.
goodFor: It suits developers and teams who require a private URL shortening service with programmatic access via an API.
watchOut: You will need to maintain and secure your own instance, which overlaps with many simpler open-source redirection tools.
deployNotes: As a PHP and Docker application, it typically requires a persistent database backend and a reverse proxy to handle TLS termination.
